en.headline: 72-year-old garage owner dies after car falls on him in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: Police said the man was crushed under a private car he was repairing when the jack apparently failed at a workshop in Sheung Tsuen on Wednesday afternoon.
body: A 72-year-old man died after being crushed by a private car while repairing it at an outdoor workshop in Tseung Kwan O on Wednesday, police said.

Officers received a report shortly before 3 pm that a man had been trapped under a vehicle at a site on Wing Lai Road in Sheung Tsuen. He was taken to Tseung Kwan O Hospital and was certified dead at about 5:03 pm. Preliminary inquiries indicated he had been working underneath the rear of his own black private car, replacing shock absorbers, when the jack supporting the vehicle collapsed.

Neighbours and passers-by helped lift the car and pulled him free before paramedics arrived. Police classified the case as death on arrival at hospital. The exact cause of death is subject to a post-mortem examination. The site was not operating as a commercial garage at the time and was mainly used by the owner for work on his own vehicles, according to people familiar with the location.

zh.headline: 將軍澳上村72歲車房東主遭私家車壓死
zh.dek: 警方表示，事主周三下午在穎禮路戶外修車場維修自己的私家車時，千斤頂疑故障，被車壓住送院後不治。
body: 警方表示，一名72歲男子周三在將軍澳上村穎禮路一個戶外修車場維修私家車時，被車輛壓住，送院後不治。
警方於下午近3時接獲報案，指一名男子被壓在車輛下。救護員到場將他送往將軍澳醫院，延至約下午5時03分證實死亡。初步調查顯示，事主當時在自己的黑色私家車車尾車底更換避震，用作支撐車輛的千斤頂突然故障塌下，將他壓住。
現場附近人士及途人協助以工具將車抬起，把事主救出。警方將案件列作送院時死亡，死因有待驗屍後確定。據了解，事發地點並非營業中的車房，事主主要在該處維修自己的車輛。
